title: Source metadata controls, held-C1 branch advance, isolated B control, and stopped-session verification
evidence_medium: Direct screenshots only; no continuous foreground-video claim.
geometry_convention: All rectangles are zero-based half-open [left, top, right, bottom). Integer crops and solid opaque masks only. No scaling, blur, reconstructed UI, or annotations.
timestamp_limit: UI event-list times are retained as displayed and not substituted for verified snapshot execution times. No payload timestamp field is visible in this pack.
control_scope: These source controls establish observations and negative controls; no newly confirmed product finding is claimed.
